description: This file contains utility functions and rendering logic for remote cursors and user identification in a collaborative drawing application, including color assignment, user initials, and cursor rendering with annotations.

methods.name: hashToInteger
methods.description: Converts a string ID to an integer hash value.

methods.name: getClientColor
methods.description: Generates a consistent HSL color string based on socket ID and collaborator info.

methods.name: getNameInitial
methods.description: Returns the first character of a name, capitalized, handling surrogate pairs.

methods.name: renderRemoteCursors
methods.description: Renders remote user cursors and associated labels on a canvas context.
